enrollment_fees.help: When an enrolment becomes active, the charge is created under Payments › Enrolments. Guardians can attach proof for admin validation.
enrollment_fees.section_desc: One-off amounts for new enrolments or renewals. Set 0 to waive.

honor_roll.section_desc: Set the minimum average for honour roll and the top of the school’s grading scale.

late_fees.help: The penalty applies once per overdue fee on the 11th. On-time or settled fees are unaffected.
late_fees.section_desc: Applied automatically on the 11th for overdue unpaid fees—fixed amount (Kz) or a percentage of the fee.

terms_holidays.section_desc: Set dates for terms 1–3 and add student holiday periods.

wizard.section_desc: Create the next school year and clone the previous structure—classes, courses, and pricing—automatically.

years.empty_state: No academic years yet. Click “New academic year” to start.
years.section_desc: Create, edit, or delete academic years. The selected year filters data across the app.
years.title_cannot_delete_active: You can’t delete the active academic year.

audit.empty: No records for the selected filters.
audit.panel_subtitle: History of creates, updates, and deletes across the school. Records are kept for 12 months.

auditoria.restricted_desc: Only school administrators or principals can view audit logs.

billing.dialog_discount_desc: Overrides the automatic rule for one student.
billing.dialog_family_desc: Applies to pupils with the same guardian.
billing.family_card_desc: When a guardian has several children at the school, a discount applies.
billing.field_from_sibling_help: 2 = from 2nd child onward; 3 = from 3rd onward; etc.
billing.iban_help: Shown in e-mails when proof mode is active. Optional but strongly recommended.
billing.mode_in_person: Pay in person at school (no file uploads from guardians)
billing.mode_proof: Proof in app / bank transfer (IBAN + school validation)
billing.overrides_desc: Overrides the automatic rule for special cases.
billing.overrides_year_hint: Discount academic year: uses the header year{{suffix}}.
billing.panel_desc: Choose how guardians handle payments in the app. With proof mode, the school IBAN appears in reminder emails.

escola.section_desc: These details appear on documents, invoices, and in the app.

billing_discounts.section_desc: How guardians pay in the app, sibling discounts, and per-student overrides (affect fee generation).

cycle.section_desc: Choose how you prefer to be billed by the platform.

invoices.section_desc: Payments made by the school to the Edukamba platform.

invite.description: One server call handles both flows: invite sends e-mail; password creates the account immediately (no “invite” wording). Adjust modules in Permissions.
invite.password_help: The user will receive an e-mail with login credentials.
invite.title: New user

marca.section_desc: Logo and colors shown across the app.

confirm_clear_role.body:
Remove all saved permissions for role “{{role}}” at this school?

Users with this role will fall back to the app defaults per module.
confirm_clear_role.title: Clear role permissions

confirm_clear_user.body: Remove all custom permissions saved for {{name}}? The user will follow only their role defaults per module.

delete_year.body: You will delete {{label}}. You can only delete if no classes, enrolments, assessments, or other linked data exist.
delete_year.title: Delete academic year

edit_user.email_help: After changing, this becomes the sign-in email across Edukamba.
edit_user.title: Edit user

remove_user.body: The user will be deactivated and lose Edukamba access immediately. You can undo this by reactivating the user.
remove_user.title: Remove user

documentos.desc: School documents, signature requests, and forms.
documentos.label: Documents

modulos.desc: Show or hide menu modules according to the plan (admins).
modulos.label: Module visibility

notas.desc: View grades by class and subject.
notas.label: Grades

professores.desc: Manage the school’s teachers and instructors.
professores.label: Teachers

propinas.desc: Billing rules, fee list, validation, and reminders.
propinas.label: School fees

refeicoes.desc: Canteen plans, billing rules, sign‑ups, and payments.
refeicoes.label: Meals

transportes.desc: Routes, stops, enrolments, and transport billing.
transportes.label: Transport

turmas.desc: Class organization by year and course.
turmas.label: Classes

notificacoes.apply_hint: Will apply to {{count}} active user(s) with role {{role}}.

event_reminder.desc: Send one day before the event.
event_reminder.label: Event reminders

invoice_issued.desc: Automatic e-mail when an invoice is issued.
invoice_issued.label: Invoices issued

welcome_email.desc: Sent when a user is created.
welcome_email.label: Welcome email

notificacoes.section_desc: Choose which notifications are sent to users in each role.

page_header.director_notice: As principal you manage users and permissions. Brand, institution data, and Edukamba invoicing remain admin-only.
page_header.subtitle: Manage your school’s general settings, brand, users, and permissions.
page_header.title: Settings

permissoes.custom_intro: Here you can delete saved permission rows for a role or a user. After removal, the app falls back to default role rules—or role plus inherited user rules—as before other tabs were saved.
permissoes.custom_role_count: Saved rows for this role at this school: {{count}}.
permissoes.custom_role_count_admin_none: No applicable rows: admins always have full access.
permissoes.custom_role_count_loading: Saved rows for this role: loading…
permissoes.custom_role_desc: Deletes all saved rows for the selected role at this school (“By role”). App defaults apply again.
permissoes.custom_user_count_loading: Custom rows for this user: loading…
permissoes.custom_user_desc: Removes overrides saved for the user (“By user”). Only the role defaults apply, with no per-module overrides.
permissoes.custom_user_hint_select: Select a user to see how many custom rows are saved.
permissoes.section_desc: Edit and save by role or user. Under “Custom permissions” you can clear saved rows and return to inherited defaults.

terms.banner_select_year: Select (or create) an academic year above to configure that year’s terms and holidays.
terms.banner_year_scope: The dates below apply only to the selected academic year. Each year has its own configuration.
terms.holidays_help: Add holiday periods visible in the academic calendar (Christmas, Easter, summer, etc.).
terms.terms_help: Set the three term dates. Each assessment is linked to the term matching its date.

toasts.academic_created: Academic year created. Edit details as needed.
toasts.role_perms_reset: Role permissions restored to app defaults.
toasts.user_perms_cleared: User overrides removed; inherited role defaults apply again.
toasts.user_removed: User removed. They can no longer access Edukamba.

validation.academic_values: Check values: 0 ≤ min average ≤ max grade.
validation.admin_always_full_access: Administrators always have full access; granular permissions are not stored.
validation.admin_no_stored_perms: The Administrator role always has full access; there are no custom rows to remove.
validation.admin_user_full_access: This account has full access; there are no per-module overrides to remove.
validation.cannot_resolve_user_role: Could not determine this user’s role.
validation.dates_order: Start date must be before end date.
validation.delete_year_blocked: Cannot delete: classes, enrolments, or fees are linked to this year.
validation.delete_year_forbidden: You may not delete this academic year. Only administrators can do that.
validation.discount_value_required: Enter a percentage or fixed amount
validation.email_required_login: Email is required (used to sign in to Edukamba).
validation.late_fee_positive: Set a late penalty greater than zero.
validation.update_email_failed: Could not update the login email.
validation.wizard_dates_desc: The end date must be after the start date.
validation.wizard_source_desc: You need a previous year to clone classes/pricing.
validation.year_required_discount_desc: Select the active academic year in the app header before creating a discount.

wizard.opt_classrooms_desc: Copies names, periods, and levels. No pupils.
wizard.opt_courses_desc: Keeps the school’s courses (Grade 1, Grade 2, etc.).
wizard.opt_fee_rules_desc: Copies amounts, recurrence, and targets (includes cloned classes where applicable).
